Project overview

The fit-out brought together seating at different levels, an open servery, a back-of-house kitchen, and a steel-framed glass entrance with a green wall.

The scope included made-to-order flooring and sandstone wall finishes, imported lighting, and fire-rated materials required for the mall setting. The project scope was execution of the interior fit-out.

Project team: Apple Fit Out Interiors
